deployment_gate: Verify the pinned authentik release and private HTTPS before enabling SMM_AUTH_ENABLED

mcp.resource_validation: Require the canonical resource at authorization and token endpoints; prove with negative integration tests on the selected release

authentication_flow.mfa: Required for all pilot identities, including Owner, Administrator and Publisher
authentication_flow.signed_amr: Must attest actual MFA, never set a constant mfa claim
authentication_flow.identity_linking: Explicit issuer+subject; never auto-link by email or JWT groups

release_acceptance: Discovery issuer matches exactly; S256 advertised and enforced
Wrong redirect, code replay, wrong verifier and wrong resource are rejected
JWT aud, azp, scope and amr satisfy the application contract
Web provider can introspect MCP tokens via the configured federation only
A revoked access token returns active=false
No CIMD or RFC9207 support is advertised unless demonstrated
MFA bypass without an enrolled device is impossible
